text:
Elaine: :loudspeaker: Heads-up — new on-prem hosting & licensing update goes into effect Mon 2026-04-05. Customers selecting Private/VPC or on-prem must sign the new Hosting Addendum and choose one of three support tiers for upgrade/patch windows. Link: https://go.redwood/hosting-addendum
Samir: Can you paste the short bullets here so I can add to the customer onboarding checklist?
Elaine: Sure — bullets below. Keeping it concise.
Elaine: • All new Private deployments require a signed Hosting Addendum (legal + infra requirements).
Elaine: • Customers must opt into a support tier: "Standard (SLA business hours)", "Premium (24/7)" or "Self-Managed (no automatic upgrades)".
Elaine: • Air-gapped/on-prem customers who want automated patches must enable a scoped support tunnel and consent to remote session logging.
Elaine: • Existing Private customers have a 90-day migration window to accept the addendum or continue under the legacy terms (limited to security-only patches).
Elaine: • New compliance checkbox for FIPS/HSM integrations — customers must provide KMS attestation during onboarding.
Samir: Nice — can we include a one-liner for sales: "No forced upgrades for Self-Managed; security fixes provided but feature/backport cadence limited."
Elaine: Yup. Add-on: pricing for dedicated backport support is available via account team.
ops-bot: Document published: <https://go.redwood/hosting-addendum|hosting-addendum> by @elaine at 3915004321
jones_legal: Quick legal note — exceptions for government/regulatory customers will be handled via an approved deviation. Please route deviation requests to legal@redwood.com with the account owner cc'd.
Matt: For customers mid-migration (we have a few in wave 2), will we auto-enroll them into Standard? Or leave them on legacy?
Elaine: We will *not* auto-enroll. Wave 2 customers will receive a notice today and a curated migration plan. If they do nothing, after 90 days they'll be on legacy security-only patching.
Natalie: Support note — for air-gapped customers that opt into the support tunnel, we will only collect session metadata and explicit debug artifacts. We will not pull customer data. Ops will share the config snippet for the limited tunnel.
Natalie: Example CLI to enable minimal support tunnel (customer side):
Natalie: ```
redwood-support enable-tunnel --scope limited --expires 72h --consent "true"
```
support_lead: Pricing impact — support sales will offer a one-time migration assistance SKU. Sales ops, please add to the quoting templates.
Samir: Good. I'll sync with AE team. Can we get a short FAQ to post on the docs site?
Elaine: Working with docs now. Expect an internal FAQ and a customer-facing FAQ by EOD tomorrow.
Samir: :thumbsup:
